say.speaker: YOU
pages: Morning. The light is wrong.
Cold. Like the flat forgot who it is heating.

say.speaker: YOU
pages: Morning. Still cold. Still nobody, as far as the flat is concerned.
The fridge won't open for me. Food, then: FRESHCO, west past the Registry.
Self-checkouts. Machines don't ask questions. They just shout.

lines: they took you off the list. not a glitch. don't call anyone.
here's a way back in. jack in to your PC.
uplink gets you in. to find anything, you want scan.so. the library on your street still lends it. don't ask nicely.
[deck] uplink.so received. hack vision: H · the board: B

say.speaker: MOTH › YOU
pages: they took you off the list. not a glitch. don't call anyone.
here's a way back in. jack in to your PC.
→ uplink.so
uplink gets you in. to find anything, you want scan.so. the library on your street still lends it. don't ask nicely.

say.speaker: YOU
pages: uplink.so. Moth wrote this. I can tell by the comments.
H: see how things work. B: the board. E at the PC, then ⌁ jack in.
touchPages: uplink.so. Moth wrote this. I can tell by the comments.
HACK, top right: see how things work. Tap the PC: ⌁ jack in.

say.speaker: MOTH › CALL
pages: Hey. It's me. Sorry I vanished on you tonight. Thanks for covering.
I can't say it on the phone. Noodles at ten, the stall by your tower. I've got something to show you.
Don't be late. I mean it.

say.speaker: YOU
pages: And the line is gone. Moth never says goodbye on the phone.

say.speaker: YOU
pages: Ten o'clock. Moth said ten, at the stall.

say.speaker: YOU
pages: Home. In through a hole in the wall, like a rumour.
Pixel is on the bed, exactly where I left it this morning.
Pixel does not care what the Registry thinks. Pixel cares that I am late.

say.speaker: YOU
pages: Rice, tins, water. Paid for with a cable. The stacker never looked up.
Home. The kettle won't boil for a stranger. But if I fill it myself, it'll still say when it's done.
And something has to be listening when it does. The counter lamp.

say.speaker: YOU
pages: Tea. The long way round, but mine.
The corner shop's light has been dying for a week. The shopkeeper fed me on credit for a year.
Maybe I can pay in wiring.

say.speaker: SHOPKEEPER
pages: Light. Real light. Sit. Eat. On the house. The house is very grateful.
You never had to have a name in here. Now you've got a friend instead. It's better. It doesn't expire.
Oh. The fixer was asking after you. Said come by the stall.

say.speaker: NOTE
pages: If you're reading this, I went quiet, and you're the friend I meant.
Building 114, west side, flat 4C. The door listens. Say it like you mean it: THE FISH KNOWS.
You saw the board? Everything wired to everything. Look at the whole thing before you touch it. — M

say.speaker: MOTH-CACHE
pages: last entry. they are not losing records. they are deleting them: a batch, a list, a reason.
the list sits on the Registry's public mirror, REG-MIRROR-7. any public terminal reaches it if you know its name. the library has one.
if I'm quiet, I'm on it. —M

say.speaker: YOU
pages: Not lost. Deleted. On a list, and Moth found the list.
REG-MIRROR-7. Any public terminal. The library has a free one, if the card slot lets me.

say.speaker: REG-MIRROR-7
pages: DELETIONS · BATCH 11 · 407 RECORDS · REASON: RESOURCE REVIEW · STATUS: COMPLETE.
#212 VARGA, INES · #213 HARBOR WORKER, CAPSULE 7B · #388 "MOTH" · ...
AUTHORISED: OFFICE OF THE REGISTRAR. COLLECTION TO FOLLOW DELETION WITHIN 30 DAYS.

say.speaker: YOU
pages: Four hundred and seven names. Mine. Moth's. VARGA, INES.
Not lost. Deleted on purpose, in a batch, with a reason: RESOURCE REVIEW.
Ines will be in the queue at the Registry. Somebody should tell her.

say.speaker: YOU
pages: Nobody stands up for A-214.
Every day for three weeks. Today, nobody.
The stall. The fixer. Now.

GOAL_HINTS.line: the public library, down the street: scan.so (Moth's tip)
